description: Shows a report to the user in a viewer with every visible slide, when the client can show one, to browse it or review the slides the slides agent changed: pass the replies' changedSlideIds to open on the first of them and mark them all. Answers the slides' ids and titles. Clients that can't show the viewer can look at the slides with getReportSlideImages instead.

id.description: The report to act on, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. Only reports whose `type` is `SlideDeck` work here: another type, such as a Google Slides presentation, returns `400`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/slides/`.

changedSlideIds.description: The slides the slides agent changed, from the replies' `changedSlideIds`, to open on the first of them and mark them all. Leave it out, or pass an empty list, to browse the report from its first slide.

name: showReport
title: Show report
